description.value: Joyful Seafood Restaurant is a Cantonese seafood destination on Kingsway in Burnaby, specializing in fresh lobster, crab, duck, and an extensive dim sum selection. The menu spans traditional preparations — steamed dumplings, rice rolls, and congee — alongside showpiece dishes like Maine lobster on e-noodles and king crab legs. Vegetarian diners are also explicitly accommodated with a range of vegetable-forward dishes.

The website explicitly mentions vegetarian options ('Joyful Seafood Restaurant also caters to vegetarians with many options available on the menu'), which is the only amenity-relevant claim found. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout — are mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags; OSM outdoor_seating=no is noted but no cycling infrastructure tags are present.
